verdict.rationale: Canny explicitly documents automatic capture of feedback from Gong (sales calls), Intercom (support tickets), Slack (chat), and other sources, plus an Autopilot feature to capture untracked conversations from these integrations. This directly matches the story's capture-intake use case across sales/support/chat channels. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the Gong/Intercom integrations' accuracy or setup depth, and detail on how Autopilot's AI classification works in practice.
